name: dl_uart_tx_path
description: Stream0 firmware TX through actual synchronous SRAM FIFO, complete-message source and two-level DL arbiter.

design_requirements.confirmation_notes: User authorized full local RTL implementation and independent self-review. This bounded native internal interface is an implementation choice under that scope, not a user-specified wire layout.

behavior: Firmware ready/valid accepts32-bit payload only when total FIFO plus actual source-held unsent words is below C_TX_DEPTH; no same-edge borrowed space. Offline preloading is allowed. A producer holds valid/data until handshake or coordinated reset.

Actual upli_receive_storage and upli_receive_fifo use authorized explicitly supplied KD28 SDP mapping/models. Both SRAM ports share i_clk; control reset invalidates ownership without clearing physical SRAM contents.
Actual dl_uart_tx_source consumes exclusively from FIFO, stages1..32 words and provides source7 to actual dl_message_arbiter. Same source/FIFO/arbiter synchronous reset is required.

The other ten already eligible single-word sources map in order to full source indices0..6,8..10; lower packed DWORD is lower source index. Other-source protocol generation/eligibility remains upstream.

Expose full service event, complete-message event, indices, captured count, held count, total capacity, TX modulo4096 and latest credit. Diagnostic ORs source/arbiter errors, over-capacity, UART done disagreement and locked/pending index disagreement.

Decoded credit is an external input. Neither this wrapper nor its simulation credit provider implements unresolved A20/UCR01 four-Flit update cadence or wire Stream Reset. Channel4 must drain before negotiated disable; coordinated local reset aborts data.
Single-clock internal native integration; no AXI, complete Endpoint/Switch, CDC synchronizer, PHY timing or full-IP signoff claim.
constraints: Verilog2001, same-line Chinese comments, one register per sequential always, no functions/tasks/raw clocks.
Single clock;640/6400ps simulation periods are characterization inputs, not timing closure or PHY throughput.
notes: Submodule contracts retain exact source and arbiter semantics. See docs/uart_tx_proof_integration_plan.md; local capacity interface is an implementation choice under authorized goal.

parameters.name: C_TX_DEPTH
parameters.scope: 128 standard profile; other capacities are local research configurations
